label: Adverbs of Place
description: A 20-question check on place and direction adverbs.

questions.prompt: What does «домой» mean in «Я иду домой после работы»?
questions.explain: «Домой» is the directional form meaning homeward, used only with motion, as it marks the destination of «иду».

questions.prompt: In «Машина быстро проехала мимо», what does the standalone «мимо» mean?
questions.explain: Standing alone with no noun, «мимо» means past or by, marking motion that passes a point without stopping.

questions.prompt: How would you say 'forward' as a direction of motion, as in «Сделай шаг ___»?
questions.explain: «Вперёд» marks real forward motion, modifying «сделай» in «Сделай шаг вперёд».

questions.prompt: «Иди вперёд, я буду впереди» contrasts two adverbs. Which one marks a static position rather than motion?
questions.explain: In this sentence «впереди» marks a static position in front, while «вперёд» marks motion forward.

questions.prompt: What does «отсюда» mean in «Уходи отсюда прямо сейчас»?
questions.explain: «Отсюда» marks the starting point of movement, meaning from this place, and answers откуда.

questions.prompt: What does «вниз» mean in «Мы быстро спускаемся вниз по лестнице»?
questions.explain: «Вниз» is an adverb of direction marking downward movement, modifying «спускаемся» and answering куда.

questions.prompt: Which adverb means 'upward' and fits «Мы поднимаемся ___ по лестнице»?
questions.explain: «Вверх» marks upward movement from low to high, modifying «поднимаемся».

questions.prompt: What does this sentence say in English: «Сделай два шага назад»?
options: Take two steps to the side.
questions.explain: «Назад» means backwards, marking the direction of the steps away from the front.

questions.prompt: What does «вокруг» mean in «Вокруг было очень тихо»?
questions.explain: Standing alone, «вокруг» means all around, describing the silence on every side.

questions.prompt: What does «прямо» mean in the directions «Идите прямо до светофора»?
questions.explain: «Прямо» means straight ahead and modifies «идите», the core word for giving walking directions.

questions.prompt: What does «около» mean in «Дети играют около дома»?
questions.explain: Here «около» governs the genitive «дома» as a preposition meaning near, marking a static location beside the house.

questions.prompt: In «Положи книгу обратно на полку», what does «обратно» tell you?
options: to put it back to its place
to leave it where it is
questions.explain: «Обратно» marks moving the book back to its place, naming the reverse direction toward the original spot.

questions.prompt: What does «вон» do in «Вон там стоит наш дом»?
questions.explain: «Вон» is a demonstrative adverb directing attention to something far off, paired with «там».

questions.prompt: In «Наша квартира этажом выше», what does «выше» mean?
questions.explain: «Выше», the comparative of высоко, marks a higher position, here one floor up as measured by «этажом».

questions.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the DIRECTIONAL form to mean 'I'm going home'?
questions.explain: «Домой» is the directional adverb used with motion, so «Я иду домой» is correct for going home.

questions.prompt: How would you tell someone to look downward, as in «Посмотри ___, там река»?
questions.explain: «Вниз» shows the downward direction of looking after «посмотри» in «Посмотри вниз, там река».

questions.prompt: What does «впереди» mean in «Впереди я вижу большой мост»?
questions.explain: «Впереди» marks what lies in front, answering где and setting the scene before «я вижу».

questions.prompt: Odd one out: three of these are directions of MOTION, but one names a static position. Which is the odd one out?
questions.explain: «Впереди» names a static position in front, while «вперёд», «вверх» and «вниз» all mark directions of motion.

questions.prompt: What does this sentence say in English: «Не смотри назад, смотри вперёд»?
questions.explain: «Назад» means look back and «вперёд» means look forward, capturing the contrast between the two directions.

questions.prompt: Odd one out: which adverb does NOT express the idea of returning or going back?
questions.explain: «Назад» and «обратно» both mark motion back toward the origin, but «сюда» simply means to here, not a return.
